notes.title: Avenger Sharks 1.3.0 Released!
notes.content:
Is it safe to go back into the water?  NO.  Because release 1.3.0 of Avenger Sharks is here, available for PC, Mac and Linux (including Steam Deck).

[b]Tired of just shooting in one direction?[/b] Be tired no longer.  We welcome SCATTER SPRAY to the power-ups that can spawn during each stage.

This release also fixes a bunch of things that were getting in the way of the sharp-toothed vengeance that players were keen to bestow upon their enemies.  Thanks to chopsteak from the Steam community for taking the time to flag these up to us.  We salute you!

[b]ENJOY YOUR CONTINUED VENGEANCE![/b]

[h1]Full release notes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Gameplay:
[list]
[*] New power up: SCATTER SPRAY
[/list][*]Bug fixes
[list][*]Player could STILL get stuck hunting for exit. Fixed. Properly this time!
[*]FISH FRENZY activated when wave ends would trap the player in the wave forever.
[*]CHEAT DEATH activated when wave ends would trap the player in the wave forever.
[*]Haptic feedback now works on MacOS (Fixed in Godot 4.3)
[/list][*]Platform:
[list][*]Godot upgrade to 4.3.stable.
[*]Steam: GodotSteam GDExtension upgraded to 4.11-gde (Stated as supporting Godot 4.3)
[*]Web: Support reinstated following Godot 4.3 fixing threads / MacOS browser issues.
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Avenger Sharks 1.2.0 (GDC Edition) Released!
notes.content:
Just in time for [url=https://gdconf.com/]GDC 2024[/url] comes version 1.2.0 of Avenger Sharks! It's available for PC, Mac and Linux (including Steam Deck) RIGHT NOW.

[b]Did you feel the need for SPEED?[/b]  The need for shark-based vengeance speed?  It is now yours.  Hitting  the left trigger or space bar will give you a SURGE of SPEED.  I call this invention 'SPEED SURGE'.  It recharges over time.  Will it tip the odds in your favour?

You asked for it, you got it: [b]ACHIEVEMENTS[/b] now feature.  Good luck in your hunting!

Finally, amongst the numerous balance tweaks (including the ability to select from THREE upgrades after each wave), there is even a [b]HOW TO PLAY[/b] screen.  Now you don't have any excuses.

[b]ENJOY YOUR CONTINUED VENGEANCE![/b]

[h1]Full patch notes[/h1]

[list]
[*]Gameplay:[list]
[*]Player can now SPEED SURGE (left trigger / SPACE) to help avoid enemies.
[*]Upgrades:[list] 
[*]Player now has a choice of 3 between waves (was: 2)
[*]NEW: HEAL ME - Restore all health ahead of the next wave.
[*]NEW: SPEED SURGE - Improves SPEED SURGE recharge time.[/list][*]Balance[list]
[*]Knight health lowered to 3 (was: 4)
[*]Trap health lowered to 4 (was: 10)
[*]CHEAT DEATH now restores 75% of player health on activation (was: 50%)
[*]Special waves can only start after Wave 3 (was: 2)
[*] Chasing enemies now use proper navigation instead of hoping for the best.  Beware![/list][/list][*]Misc:[list] 
[*]Graphics: 'DINNER TIME' particle effects added.
[*]How To Play screen added.
[*]Adjusted player movement at wave start to commence at the entrance door.
[*][INTERNAL] Added godot-git-plugin.[/list][*]Platform:[list]
[*]STEAM ACHIEVEMENTS![list]
[*]Beat 1 / 5 / 10 waves in arcade mode.
[*]Rescue 100 / 500 / 1000 fish.
[*][HIDDEN] Fail to clear the first wave.[/list][/list][*]Bug fixes:[list]
[*]Deadlock could occur on upgrade screen if there weren't enough eligible upgrades. 
[*]CHEAT DEATH could persist between games.  Upgrades now more consistently reset.
[*]Player could get stuck hunting for key or exit.  Proper navigation implemented to avoid this.
[*]Enemies would vanish too early when the wave ended during SHARK ATTACK.
[*]Shark spray sound not synced properly with gameplay.
[*]Countdown sound would keep playing when returning to main menu.
[*]Game ending when in FISH FRENZY would result in player stuck at a weird angle.
[*]Player, Mini Shark and Dinosaur projectiles not despawning on game ending.[/list][/list]

notes.title: Avenger Sharks 1.1.0 Released!
notes.content:
It brings me great pleasure to announce that version 1.1.0 of Avenger Sharks is now available for PC, Mac and Linux (including Steam Deck).

This release introduces some key changes:

Firstly, [b]the waves are now TIME BASED[/b].  This keeps the action nice and frenetic throughout.  No easy ride as you get close to the end of a wave!  Your shark-based thirst for vengeance must continue at all times.

A new power-up has been introduced.  [b]Watch for the magical non-derivative star[/b].  If you find it, your hunger will increase by a factor of ten gazillion.  Your enemies will fear you.  YOU CAN EAT THEM.  Use this new-found power wisely.

[b]Artillery strikes[/b] have been introduced into some waves.  Because, well, just because reallly.

Finally, various[b] performance updates[/b] have been made to help ensure an increased and more consistent FPS.

Full patch notes are lower down.  

ENJOY YOUR CONTINUED VENGEANCE!

[previewyoutube=WWZsfjlBqEA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Full patch notes[/h1]

[list]
[*]Gameplay:[list]
[*]Waves: These are now TIME based to keep the action fast, fresh and furious.
[*]New power-up: A magical star that allows your shark to eat the now very scared enemies!
[*]Artillery: Watch out for POLLUTION STRIKES from above!
[*]Spawning: Avoid spawn types at beginning of wave that give player too much space.
[*]AI: Chasing enemies re-orient more often.
[*]Knockback: Some enemies are now knocked back when hit.[/list][*]Performance:[list]
[*]FPS improved as follows...[list]
[*]Switched to the Forward+ renderer (Was: 'Compatibility').
[*]Particles now switched to GPU.
[*]Replace PointLight2D lighting effects on projectiles with Sprite2D equivalent.[/list][/list][*]Sound:[list]
[*]New music tracks for menu and gameplay.  Enjoy!
[*]Countdown effect towards end of wave.
[*]Grenade volume lowered slightly.[/list][*]Bug fixes:[list]
[*]Diet: At some point, Necromancers stopped wanting to eat fish.  Fixed.
[*]UI: Tightened up mouse showing / hiding as appropriate[/list][*]Platform:[list]
[*]Steam : GodotSteam GDExtension upgraded to 4.6.[/list][*]Misc:[list]
[*]Haptic feedback added! Vibrates on player hit + shark frenzy.  Turn on in OPTIONS.[list]
[*]This will not work on all platforms.[list]
[*]Example for MacOS Sonoma - [url=https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/88674]https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/88674[/url][/list][/list][*]Improved alignment of death animations.
[*]Fish now swim off to freedom once rescued.
[*]Pause improvements:[list]
[*]ESC can be used to unpause.
[*]Can now pause game during WAVE START, WAVE END and UPGRADE SCREEN.[/list][*]Debug menu to keep an eye on performance (toggle modes with F3).
[*]Removed some spurious debug print() statements.[/list][/list]

notes.title: Avenger Sharks has LAUNCHED!
notes.content:
The day of shark-based VENGEANCE has arrived.  Avenger Sharks is now enjoying its first dip into the Steam release waters.

Grab a controller.  Control a shark.  Get some vengeance.

Remember: Right trigger is used to use your FISH FRENZY when your bar has filled up!  Or the 'E' key if you are using mouse and keys.  THE CHOICE IS YOURS, my fishy friend.

The latest updates revolve around 'quality of life' for Steam certification.

[list]
[*] Steam: Bringing up Steam Overlay during game automatically pauses.
[*] UI: Disable TAB key (avoids Steam Overlay weird behaviour)
[*] UI: Hide mouse pointer when mouse is not being used
[/list]
